notes.title: News from Questscape: On the way to the early access!
notes.content:
Dear adventurers,

The gates of Questscape are about to open to the world of players! With a first level and tutorial, we are in the midst of preparations for our Early Access launch. Intensive internal tests are currently underway to ensure that your entry into the world of Questscape is an unforgettable experience.

But that's not all! Our team is tirelessly working to make the gaming experience even more exciting. We have our sights set on the multiplayer mode and controls, and we're striving to have them ready in time for Early Access. Your feedback is paramount to us – we will carefully listen to and implement your wishes and suggestions.

Even after Early Access, we will continue to work on new content and features to continuously improve the game and enrich your gaming experience.

Your support and feedback are invaluable to us. Therefore, we will initially release Questscape in Early Access mode to capture your thoughts and ideas directly. And while we are currently focusing on English and German, translation into other languages is already firmly planned to enable even more players to access Questscape.

Stay tuned, adventurers – the journey through Questscape is about to begin! We can't wait to welcome you to our world and experience unforgettable adventures together.

With a thirst for adventure,

The Questscape Team
